question: Which band, Letters to Cleo or Screaming Trees, had more members?

citations.claim: Letters to Cleo had six members: Kay Hanley, Greg McKenna, Michael Eisenstein, Stacy Jones, Scott Riebling, and later, Tom Polce.
Screaming Trees had five distinct members: Mark Lanegan, Gary Lee Conner, Van Conner, Mark Pickerel, and Barrett Martin (who replaced Pickerel).
